clue.text: Consecrate a Rodin sculpture

indicators.note: a sculpture is something shaped and moulded, so these letters are remodelled into a new form

explanation.surface: Someone blesses a statue by the French master Rodin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sculpture' reshapes the letters of A RODIN.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain a priest is to consecrate them, setting them apart for holy office.

clue.text: Wherein a number in the party were confined during the War

definitions.text: Wherein a number in the party were confined during the War

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other, here A and a number inside the party

parts.note: a stag is a men-only party held before a wedding
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A description of a wartime prison camp where a group of men were held.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A plus L (fifty in Roman numerals) inside STAG. The whole clue doubles as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stalag was a German prisoner-of-war camp for ordinary soldiers in the Second World War.

clue.text: Cheerful in an extremely pointed way

definitions.meaning: taken literally, as sharp as a pin fresh from the packet

explanation.surface: Someone is jolly but in a sharp, barbed manner.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means spruce and gleaming, so bright and cheerful, while a new pin is literally as sharp as can be.

clue.text: Hold a number betraying nation

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: betraying a nation sells it out and turns it over, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone holds a number of people who are betraying their country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'betraying' is the anagram signal; the surface reads it as treachery. 'A number' is the Roman numeral for a hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: To contain something is to hold it within, as a jug holds water.

clue.text: Came up against a science requiring logical analysis

parts.note: met means encountered or came up against
mathematics is the science of number and space

explanation.surface: Someone encountered a branch of science that needs careful logical thought.
explanation.definitionFit: Metamathematics is the study of mathematics itself by means of formal logic, examining proofs and systems.

clue.text: Galleys of the merriest sort

indicators.note: of the merriest sort tells us to sort, or rearrange, the letters of merriest

explanation.surface: Ships described as the most cheerful kind around.
explanation.definitionFit: Triremes were ancient warships rowed by three banks of oars, a kind of galley.

clue.text: Sounds like the bird has been transfixed

definitions.text: Sounds like the bird has been transfixed

parts.words: Sounds like the bird has been transfixed
parts.note: the seabird's first half is said like skewer, so the name sounds like a gull run through by a spit

explanation.surface: A remark that a bird appears to have been pierced right through.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a seabird name for the great skua, a large predatory gull-like species.

clue.text: Nothing, or in proportion, a good many notes

parts.note: O is nought, nothing

indicators.note: in places one word inside another, here or inside proportion

parts.note: a ratio is a proportion

explanation.surface: A statement about nothing and proportional amounts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a good many notes' looks like a quantity but is the definition of a long musical work.
explanation.definitionFit: An oratorio is a long choral and orchestral work, so it holds a great many musical notes.

clue.text: A Greek expression I've discovered

definitions.meaning: it is a Greek word meaning I have found it
the exclamation Archimedes made on finding his principle in the bath

explanation.definitionFit: Archimedes supposedly shouted this Greek word, meaning I have found it, on his discovery in the bath.

clue.text: An eccentric over a barrel

indicators.note: over in a down-reading sense turns the barrel word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: a tun is a large barrel for wine or beer

explanation.surface: A strange person held at a disadvantage.
explanation.definitionFit: A nut is slang for a crazy or eccentric person.

clue.text: See this and the solution may be clear

definitions.text: See this and the solution may be clear

parts.words: See this and the solution may be clear
parts.note: seeing it means finally understanding, as in seeing the light at last

explanation.surface: A hint that a puzzle will be solved once something is spotted.
explanation.definitionFit: To see daylight is an idiom for at last understanding a problem, when everything becomes clear.

clue.text: His up-and-down life puts a strain on him

parts.note: a strain is a tune, an air
him is a man

explanation.surface: A man whose life of ups and downs puts him under stress.
explanation.definitionFit: A flyer of aircraft spends their working life going up and coming down.

clue.text: Noble old heavyweight fighters

parts.note: titled medieval warriors weighed down by plate steel, playing on heavyweight boxers

explanation.surface: Distinguished former heavyweight boxers.
explanation.definitionFit: Medieval mounted warriors of noble rank wore heavy metal plate, making them literally heavyweight fighters.

clue.text: It's the devil in him, perhaps

indicators.note: in shows the letters are lodged within the words that follow

explanation.surface: There is something devilish in a certain man.
explanation.definitionFit: An imp is a little devil or mischievous sprite.

clue.text: Bring peace with a very quiet form of relief

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quiet
ease means relief from pain or worry

explanation.surface: Someone makes peace through a gentle kind of comfort.
explanation.definitionFit: To appease is to pacify or calm, bringing quiet to a dispute.

clue.text: Before a S. African province came into being?

definitions.text: Before a S. African province came into being?

parts.note: pre is a prefix meaning before
Natal was a province of South Africa

explanation.surface: A historical query about the time before a South African province was founded.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: before birth is before one 'came into being'.
explanation.definitionFit: Prenatal means existing before birth, the time before someone has come into being.

clue.text: Used to catch slippery customers taking fruit

definitions.text: Used to catch slippery customers taking fruit

parts.note: eels are famously slippery creatures
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: A device for catching shifty types who steal fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines the tool as well as building it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fishing implement is a pronged spear for catching eels.

clue.text: Pipe for an American painter right away

indicators.note: away tells us the letter for right is taken off

parts.note: James McNeill Whistler was an American painter

explanation.surface: A tobacco pipe for an American artist, delivered straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away' removes R (right) from WHISTLER, the American painter.
explanation.definitionFit: To pipe is to whistle, making a shrill high sound.

clue.text: Japanese fish with a sound obligation

indicators.note: with a sound means the word for obligation is heard rather than written

parts.note: a tie is a binding obligation

explanation.surface: A fish from Japan that carries a solid duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' means TIE is heard, giving TAI.
explanation.definitionFit: Tai is the Japanese sea bream, a prized fish in Japanese cookery.

clue.text: Singer one associates with the bagpipes

definitions.meaning: the pipe on which bagpipe melodies are fingered

explanation.definitionFit: A chanter is one who chants a song, and also the melody pipe of a bagpipe.

clue.text: As Ruth was said to be amid the alien corn

definitions.text: As Ruth was said to be amid the alien corn

parts.words: As Ruth was said to be amid the alien corn
parts.note: Keats in his Ode to a Nightingale pictures the biblical Ruth, sick for home, standing in tears amid the alien corn

explanation.surface: A literary allusion to Ruth in a foreign field of grain.
explanation.definitionFit: Keats wrote that Ruth was 'sick for home' in a foreign land, longing for her native country.

clue.text: Cross-Channel organisation of certain note

parts.note: sure means certain
te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A body across the English Channel with a guaranteed musical tone.
explanation.walkthrough: Cross-Channel means across the English Channel from Britain, that is, in France.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sûreté is the French police detective department, across the Channel from Britain.

clue.text: The best of health, say

parts.note: a toast wishing good health is a word said on raising glasses

explanation.surface: Someone raises a glass to wish good health.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a toast offered when drinking, wishing others good health.

clue.text: Fruit two feet long!.

indicators.note: two means the word for a foot is written twice over

parts.note: a paw is an animal's foot

explanation.surface: A piece of fruit that measures a couple of feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The pawpaw, or papaya, is a tropical fruit.

clue.text: Men of deeds barring one sign of the zodiac

parts.note: barring means excluding, not
Aries the Ram is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: Men of action, apart from those born under one star sign.
explanation.definitionFit: Notaries are lawyers who draw up and certify legal documents called deeds.

clue.text: Place returning sheep

indicators.note: returning means the word for the sheep comes back, read backwards

parts.note: a tup is a ram, a male sheep

explanation.surface: Somewhere the sheep come back to.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something is to place it somewhere.

clue.text: Point a fair way out for an excursion…

parts.note: S, south, is a point of the compass

indicators.note: way out means wild or strange, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Showing someone the exit from a funfair for a day trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way out' rearranges A FAIR into AFARI, after S for south.
explanation.definitionFit: A safari is an expedition or excursion, typically to view wildlife.

clue.text: … and the rest

parts.note: continuing the previous clue's ellipsis: a phrase meaning and so on, and other things

explanation.surface: The clue simply trails on from the last one with a vague 'and so on'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase means 'and other things', standing for the rest of a list.
